verdict.rationale: Fenwick's Startup Resource Center publishes formation-stage material, including an "Incorporation Stage Issues" overview of common issues founders face at incorporation. Nothing in the evidence shows guidance comparing entity types or jurisdictions, and the firm lists only US offices. Missing for 10: explicit entity-type selection guidance, Delaware C-corp jurisdiction analysis, UK Ltd / German GmbH/UG / Indian Pvt Ltd coverage, market-specific choice-of-jurisdiction content, and independent corroboration.
